limitations: The complete FFmpeg/toolchain build and bit-for-bit reproducibility have not been run.

Upstream deleted rav1e build-directory Cargo.lock. The resolved lock is reconstructed from its pinned original and the original build log, and is not claimed to be byte-identical to that deleted file.
Locked Rust inputs include optional, test and non-Windows dependencies. Their presence in the source attachment and notices does not identify them as linked code.

The collector retains upstream archives and notices; some crates declare their license in Cargo.toml without bundling a standalone text, so the notices add canonical terms and record the scope of supplemental upstream attribution.
The prepared runtime matches the original upstream executable bytes. Application packaging may add an Authenticode distribution signature.
verificationScope: Verified source collection: exact binary archive byte correspondence; reviewed target-specific recipe inputs, nested sources, locked crates and license materials; complete compressed archive reads. This is not a rebuilt-binary result.
